profile.name: 可寻址行记录存储组件
profile.description: 一种非物理的软件文件存储组件，用于读写以换行分隔的记录，并维护行索引以实现按行快速定位。适合在实验过程中保存日志、样本记录、目录清单和相关元数据。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software file storage component for reading and writing newline-delimited records while maintaining a line index for fast random access by line. It is useful in experiments for storing logs, sample records, catalogs, manifests, and related metadata.

registry.name: Seekable
registry.description: Seekable是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、写入数据、启动、记录、读取数据、运行。支持Signal, Slot, add deleted indexes等操作。
